description: This file defines a function `createPartialResponse` that generates a partial content response for HTTP range requests, mainly used for serving byte ranges of a resource. It handles existing partial responses and constructs new ones based on the Range header, utilizing utility functions for boundary calculations and parsing.

classes.name: WorkboxError
classes.description: Custom error class for handling Workbox-specific error scenarios.

methods.name: createPartialResponse(request, originalResponse)
methods.description: Generates a partial content response for a given request and original response, fulfilling the byte-range request as specified by the Range header. Returns a new Response object with status 206 or 416 based on the input.
